newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end sharply up on heavy buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end sharply up on heavy buying.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed sharply higher on Tuesday, with three months hitting their daily 400 yen limit on active buying from local investors, traders said.
The benchmark July 1998 ended up 400 yen at 14,010 yen per tonne. Estimated volume was 45,550 lots.
The yen's fall against the dollar and the rally in CBOT corn futures triggered heavy buying here, traders said.
The spot September corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.53-1/4 per bushel at 0840 GMT, against $2.50-1/2 at Monday's close.
The spot August CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.62-1/2 per bushel at 0840 GMT, against $7.57-3/4 at Monday's close.
